data.name: Nasihah
data.gender_notes: Nasihah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nasihah is an Arabic name which means 'good advice'. It is a unisex name, given to both boys and girls. In Islamic tradition, Nasihah is considered a very virtuous name, symbolizing wisdom and a strong moral compass. The name Nasihah carries the meaning “Good advice” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nasihah usually hope their child will grow to embody good advice and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual interpretation of Nasihah is that it represents divine guidance, leading to a life of wisdom and righteousness.
data.etymology: Nasihah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good advice.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasihah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
